title: Behavior Intervention Services
description: behaviorinterventionservices.com Behavior Intervention Services LLC is a behavioral health company founded in 2008 in St. Louis, Missouri, providing ABA therapy, neuropsychological evaluation, mental health treatment and forensic assessment across Missouri, Kansas, Illinois and Iowa. With 200 to 500 employees including BCBAs, registered behavior technicians and neuropsychologists, it serves children and adults with autism, ADHD, learning disabilities and mental health conditions. Its services cover home-based and center-based ABA therapy, early intervention, social skills training, parent coaching and cognitive assessment. The company also provides court-ordered forensic evaluations including competency assessments and immigration evaluations. It accepts Medicaid, TRICARE and most private insurance plans. Revenue is estimated at 10 to 30 million dollars with over 10 office locations across the Midwest.
